library/anne-of-green-gables/maps/avonle.notes: Accepted after visual review. The district reads as mature rural topography; deterministic red-earth routes and all fifteen labels remain legible over the base, including the sole marked pond crossing.

library/anne-of-green-gables/maps/charlo.notes: Accepted after visual review. The harbor, wharves, street grid, gardens, civic grounds and exhibition field form a coherent period city map; all four story-site overlays are legible.

library/anne-of-green-gables/maps/green-.notes: Accepted after correction and visual review. The illustrated estate has clear orchard, farmyard, brook, house and barn; a translucent deterministic inset preserves the four room markers without erasing the terrain.

library/anne-of-green-gables/maps/prince.notes: Accepted after visual review. Rich island terrain is clipped to the verified Natural Earth coastline; open-water texture is sampled separately so generated shoreline drift cannot alter geography.
